lab.name: Autonomous Cognition and Control Laboratory
lab.tagline: Research at the convergence of control theory and artificial intelligence, with applications in robotics, energy storage, and fault diagnostics and prognostics.
lab.about: Our group focuses on research at the convergence of control theory and artificial intelligence and their applications in robotics, energy storage, and fault diagnostics and prognostics. We aim to develop resource-aware control, computationally efficient real-time learning, and smart battery management systems for health-conscious decision-making.
lab.department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

announcement.text: Ph.D. positions available in Robotics, Control, Deep & Reinforcement Learning, and Energy Storage.

themes.title: Control of Cyber-Physical Systems
themes.text: Spatially distributed systems bring spatiotemporal behavior, heavy communication requirements, network constraints, and privacy and security vulnerabilities. Networked autonomous systems must learn uncertain dynamics, detect impending failures or attacks, isolate compromised components, adapt control, and resume stable operation.

themes.title: Artificial Intelligence for Control
themes.text: Real-time learning for control is notoriously challenging. Resource-constrained edge devices, the need for dependable and provable behavior, and safety, security, and verification in human-in- and human-on-the-loop systems make implementation harder.

areas.title: Control
items: Autonomous cognition for inference and filtering
Security and privacy of learning-based controllers

areas.title: Robotics
items: Safe deep reinforcement learning for navigation and path planning
Autonomous robotic inspection of energy infrastructure
Safe, data-enabled control of human-in-the-loop manipulators

applications.title: Intelligent Battery Management
applications.text: Lithium-ion batteries are the workhorse of electric vehicles. Key challenges include accurate state-of-health estimation, real-time learning of battery models, internal fault detection, and vulnerability to thermal runaway.

applications.title: Electric Machinery Health Management
applications.text: Embedding machines with intelligent fault diagnostics and prognostics algorithms so they can self-detect faults and predict remaining useful life, avoiding unplanned downtime and cost.
